patch_description: The added RX pre-shift layer hurt performance (0.44 vs 0.53). I revert to the stronger prior block (RY decode, CRY entanglers, RY/RX readout) and then apply the suggested orbit-split: the single shared `cry_endpoint_to_mid` is split into horizontal-edge and vertical-edge keys, and `cry_mid_to_center`/`cry_center_to_mid` are split into row vs. column keys. This lets the circuit independently weight row and column line correlations (tic-tac-toe rows and columns are distinct winning lines), addressing underfitting with only a modest parameter increase, while keeping D4-respecting orbit sharing for efficiency.
